descriptionChirho: A person who unlawfully kills another; used of literal murderers (Matt 22:7 the king's retribution on murderers; Acts 7:52 murderers of the Righteous One; Acts 28:4 Paul presumed a murderer; 1 Pet 4:15 suffering as a murderer; Rev 21:8, 22:15 murderers excluded from the holy city). Singular and plural forms are purely inflectional. Multilingual evidence is consistent: Spanish 'asesino(s)/homicida', Arabic 'قَاتِل(ون)', Korean '살인자(들)', Swahili 'muuaji/wauaji', Hindi 'हत्यारा/हत्यारों'.
